title: Dekisugi-kun — Learn science by teaching
capture: Real native v8/v10 teaching and need recordings plus new v12 English prediction, purchase, family-plan and self-check interactions. Retained teaching clips crop the unrelated metrics bar; new captures show current English UI. No fabricated UI or seeded progress. Separate adult Test Store profile; no real charge. Developer self-check replay is not learner efficacy data.

scenes.title: Can you explain why things fall?
narration: Can you explain why things fall? Dekisugi-kun turns that question into a lesson you teach.

scenes.title: Predict. Read. Check conditions.
narration: Predict first. Then read the principle and its conditions.
Here, air resistance must be negligible.

scenes.title: Hide the material.
scenes.tag: Core learning works offline · No account
narration: Now, hide the material and teach it back.

scenes.title: Explain in your own words.
scenes.tag: Text alongside voice · No external AI grading
narration: I explain in my own words.
Text is a full route, alongside voice. Student explanations stay on the device.

scenes.title: Reread. Reflect.
scenes.tag: Key-term coverage is not a mastery score
narration: I reread my explanation. Key terms prompt reflection, not a mastery score.

scenes.title: Apply the idea.
scenes.tag: A fixed question · The learner does the thinking
narration: A fixed follow-up asks me to apply the idea.

scenes.title: A hint. Another try.
narration: A wrong choice brings a hint about the vacuum condition.
I rethink my explanation and try again.

scenes.title: Keep a purpose for review.
scenes.tag: Rewriting alone does not clear an observed need
narration: Uncertain ideas stay in the record for review.

scenes.title: Plus helps families review.
scenes.tag: Separate Test Store demo · No real charge · Core lessons free
narration: RevenueCat powers optional Plus. This is a Test Store purchase, without a real charge.
Parents get a next-review topic, questions to ask, and a shareable report. Core lessons stay free.

scenes.title: A free understanding check.
scenes.tag: Developer replay · Draft check · Learner efficacy not measured
narration: A free self-check tests the principle and a new situation. Learner effectiveness has not been measured yet.
